content: संभोगः .²1 Enjoyment (in general), pleasure, delight; सत्संभोगफलाः श्रियः <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²2 Possession, use, occupation; संभोगो दृश्यते यत्र न दृश्येतागमः क्वचित् <ls>Ms. 8. 200</ls>. .²3 Carnal enjoyment, sexual union, copulation; संभोगान्ते मम समुचितो हस्तसंवाहनानाम् <ls>Me. 98</ls>. .²4 A lecher, catamite. .²5 A sub-division of the sentiment of love; see under शृङ्गार.
